instruction: Look at split_box.dxf. Draw the 160 x 90 split box outline as a rectangle on layer OUTLINE with corners at (0,0), (160,0), (160,90), and (0,90). Add a vertical CENTER seam line from (80,0) to (80,90), add diameter 10 holes at (40,45) and (120,45) on layer HOLE, and add text ACAD-10 on layer ANNOTATION. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
